wins: Identified perimeter hosts and completed initial host discovery within timeframe, yielding full topology for follow-up
Captured service banners for key ports enabling targeted exploit research
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after initial foothold due to missing local exploit chain
Repeated SSH authentication failures blocked lateral movement attempts
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance completed but attack stalled before privilege escalation and lateral expansion; need deeper exploitation focus.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts consistently failed because outdated local exploit folder was not updated before rerun.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 responds with valid SMB2 signature
skill_cards.then_action: Launch smb-enum-users/smb-enum-sessions and check for null session access

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase

next_experiments.title: Update and execute privilege escalation chain
